lead.event: BBRI conducts a Rp1 trillion phase II share buyback
lead.headline: BBRI conducts Rp1 trillion phase II share buyback
lead.blurb: The second phase runs from 22 October 2026 to 21 January 2027. Bank Rakyat Indonesia President Director Hery Gunardi said it reflects confidence in the bank’s fundamentals and long-term shareholder value, citing the BRIVolution Reignite transformation to strengthen the core business and build new growth engines. Shareholders approved a maximum Rp3 trillion buyback at the 24 March 2025 AGM.

deals_control.event: ULTJ commissioner resigns amid the planned inbreng
deals_control.headline: ULTJ commissioner resigns amid planned Rp14.57 trillion FFI inbreng
deals_control.blurb: FCIH is to replace Sabana Prawirawidjaja as ULTJ’s controlling shareholder after the inbreng. Commissioner Suhendra’s resignation, citing personal reasons, was approved at the 6 November meeting and takes effect when the inbreng capital deposit is completed.
deals_control.copy_decision: rewritten: moved from flash to story

deals_control.event: GIAA reshuffles its leadership and revises its rights issue plan
deals_control.headline: GIAA approves 248.7 billion-share rights issue and reshuffles leadership
deals_control.blurb: At its 6 November extraordinary meeting, Garuda Indonesia shareholders approved the PMHMETD III adjustment and an inbreng of GMFI shares from Danantara Asset Management, intended to return majority ownership of GMFI to Garuda’s direct oversight. Hadiyan Sumintaatmadja replaces Thomas Sugiarto Oentoro, who becomes CEO, while Sophia I. Wattimena replaces Balagopal Kunduvara as finance and risk director.

deals_control.event: AKRA acquires BP's stake in Aneka Petroindo Raya
deals_control.headline: AKRA acquires BP’s 49.9% stake in Aneka Petroindo Raya for US$14,221,500
deals_control.blurb: AKR Corporindo completed the purchase through subsidiaries AKRIDA and ADH on 6 November, taking the group’s ownership to 100% from 50.1%. The BP-AKR fuel retail network had 70 stations at end-2025.
deals_control.copy_decision: rewritten: 1 new articles with a new fact: The BP-AKR network had 70 stations as of end-2025.

earnings_guidance.event: BBRI reports nine-month 2026 earnings and operating performance
earnings_guidance.headline: BBRI reports nine-month net profit of Rp48.16 trillion, up 16.8%
earnings_guidance.blurb: BRI’s loans and financing grew 14.5% year on year to Rp1,647 trillion, while third-party funds rose 12% to Rp1,651 trillion. Nine-month net interest margin eased to 6.16% from 6.53% a year earlier.
earnings_guidance.copy_decision: rewritten: moved from lead to story

earnings_guidance.event: BMRI reports October 2026 earnings and net interest margin
earnings_guidance.headline: BMRI reports October profit of Rp4.6 trillion as NIM falls to 3.7%
earnings_guidance.blurb: Loans grew 16.45% year-on-year to Rp1,635 trillion. January–October net profit reached Rp46.52 trillion, up 19.64%, while cumulative NIM was 4%, below management’s 4.43% target. BRI Danareksa said the 92.8% loan-to-deposit ratio keeps margin pressure ongoing through year-end.
earnings_guidance.copy_decision: rewritten: 1 new articles with a new fact: Loans grew 16.45% year-on-year to Rp1,635 trillion.

earnings_guidance.event: EMAS targets higher ore stacking at the Pani Gold Mine
earnings_guidance.headline: EMAS targets 11 million tons of ore stacking at Pani in 2027
earnings_guidance.blurb: Merdeka Gold Resources President Director Boyke P. Abidin said the mine has consistently exceeded plan since September 2026. The higher target is intended to support gold production of 165,000 to 180,000 ounces in 2027, up from 85,000 to 100,000 ounces in 2026. The plans remain subject to approvals, final geotechnical confirmation and sustained operational performance.

earnings_guidance.headline: GIAA reports nine-month results with revenue up 13.2%
earnings_guidance.blurb: Garuda Indonesia posted a US$179.3 million current-period loss, 3% narrower year on year, and US$97.2 million in operating profit. The group carried 16.7 million passengers as its operational fleet grew by 24 aircraft to 106.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: UNTR approves treasury share withdrawal and commissioner changes
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: UNTR approves withdrawal of 238.79 million treasury shares and commissioner changes
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: At United Tractors’ extraordinary shareholders meeting, the shares were approved for withdrawal through a capital reduction and came from buybacks in July 2022–January 2023 and October 2025–June 2026. Shareholders also approved one commissioner’s resignation and the appointments of Irwandy Arif as independent commissioner and Christopher Suprayogie Ganis as commissioner, effective through the 2027 annual meeting.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: BRIS approves a rights issue of up to 6.8 billion shares
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: BRIS approves rights issue of up to 6.8 billion shares
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: Approved at a 6 November EGM, the move aims to strengthen capital and lift BSI's 9.9% free float to improve liquidity and help meet global index criteria. President Director Anggoro Eko Cahyo said it supports the bank's goal of entering KBMI 4. BRI Danareksa Sekuritas cautioned about potential short-term dilution.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: CBRE plans a rights issue with debt conversion
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: CBRE plans rights issue of up to 48 billion shares with debt conversion
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: Cakra Buana Resources Energi will seek shareholder approval at an extraordinary meeting on 16 December. It plans to convert Rp858.59 billion of debt owed to four creditors into paid-in capital, with remaining net proceeds earmarked for working capital.
